title: Merge stack-level actions into object definitions so action buttons render
body:
Example objects (CRM, Todo, Kitchen Sink, MSW-Todo) declared actions as flat arrays at the stack level in `defineStack()`, but nothing merged them into individual object schemas. `objectDef.actions` was always empty, so `ActionBar`/`ActionButton` never rendered anywhere.

### Core fix: `mergeActionsIntoObjects()` helper

Mirrors the existing `mergeViewsIntoObjects()` pattern — applied post-`defineStack()` in both `objectstack.config.ts` and `apps/console/objectstack.shared.ts`.

Matching strategy: longest object-name prefix wins (`order_item_adjust_quantity` → `order_item`, not `order`), with explicit `objectName` fallback for edge cases.

```ts
// project_task actions are prefixed "task_", not "project_task_"
{
  name: 'task_change_status',
  objectName: 'project_task',  // explicit override
  ...
}
```

### New action definitions

- **Todo** (`task.actions.ts`): 6 actions — complete, start, clone, defer, set_reminder, assign
- **Kitchen Sink** (`showcase.actions.ts`): 3 actions — change_status, assign_owner, archive
- **MSW-Todo** (`objectstack.config.ts`): 3 actions — task_complete, task_reopen, task_delete
- **CRM**: existing 26 actions now merge correctly; added `objectName: 'project_task'` to 2 project actions

### `list_toolbar` batch actions & `bulkEnabled`

Actions that support batch/multi-select operations now include `list_toolbar` location and `bulkEnabled: true`:
- Todo: `todo_task_complete`, `todo_task_assign`
- CRM: `account_assign_owner`, `contact_send_email`, `opportunity_change_stage`
- Kitchen Sink: `showcase_change_status`, `showcase_assign_owner`
- MSW-Todo: `task_complete`, `task_delete`

### `visible` conditional expressions

Actions now include `visible` expressions for context-aware rendering:
- Opportunity: `stage !== 'closed_won' && stage !== 'closed_lost'` (all 3 actions)
- Contact: `type !== 'Customer'` (convert action)
- Todo: `is_completed === false` (complete), `status === 'Backlog' || status === 'Todo'` (start), `status !== 'Done'` (defer)
- Showcase: `status !== 'archived'` (change_status, archive)
- MSW-Todo: `is_completed === false` (complete), `is_completed === true` (reopen)

### Wiring

- `examples/todo/objectstack.config.ts` — imports + `actions: [...TodoTaskActions]`
- `examples/kitchen-sink/objectstack.config.ts` — imports + `actions: [...ShowcaseActions]`
- `examples/msw-todo/objectstack.config.ts` — inline `TaskActions` + `actions: [...TaskActions]`
- Root config and console shared config apply `mergeActionsIntoObjects()` after `mergeViewsIntoObjects()`

### Result

All 4 examples now have actions: CRM (26 actions across 10 objects), Todo (6), Kitchen Sink (3), MSW-Todo (3) — 35 total actions across 13 objects. `kitchen_sink` intentionally has none (field-types demo). All actions include complete metadata: locations, icons, params, confirmText, successMessage, refreshAfter, visible expressions, and bulkEnabled where appropriate.

> <issue_description>### 问题描述
> 示例仓库（如examples/todo、examples/crm等）的对象定义（object.object.ts/config）均未包含actions（纯fields）。actions均以栈顶层单独数组声明，没有自动merge，导致Console、Studio、低代码设计器、app-demo-console、PWA等所有界面业务Action按钮/批量Action菜单全部不可见。
> 
> ### 预期行为
> - 每个对象（task/contact等）都需有明确的actions字段（内联定义或通过插件注册自动合并）
> - actions需带locations（record_header/list_toolbar/list_item等）和完整metadata（图标、visible/disabled表达式、成功消息、批量/单条等）
> - /api/v1/meta/objects/:name 获取到的schema含actions字段，Console/Studio能实时渲染
> 
> ### 实现建议
> - 参照examples/crm/src/actions/*.actions.ts里的结构，每个对象都补充actions声明
> - 要么内联到objectSchema，要么在config里actions并配合AppPlugin自动merge机制
> - Todo示例应补全[完整按钮清单](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/issues/840#issuecomment)和handler（如completeTask, startTask, cloneTask, deferTask, setReminder等）
> - 保证API返回对象元数据含actions属性，前端无需任何手工merge
> 
> ### 价值
> - 完整支持可视ActionBar、ActionButton、ActionMenu所有位置批量/单条操作及二次开发使用
> - 对齐ServiceNow/Salesforce/Power Platform等主流SaaS一体化行为
>
